title: Reinstatement Fee Billed on Restoring Parking License Privileges
content:
Parking receivable accounting standard, Parking License: the reinstatement fee billed when suspended privileges are restored.

## Clause

Restoring suspended privileges sets the license back to active and bills the reinstatement fee with the restoration; the reinstatement fee falls due with the next monthly fee and is not part of the cure amount. The reinstatement fee is the product's reinstatement fee, rounded half up to the cent.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Condition | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| suspended privileges are restored | the license is set back to active | the reinstatement fee is billed with the restoration |
| the reinstatement fee has been billed | it is not part of the cure amount | it falls due with the next monthly fee |

## Illustration (hypothetical product whose reinstatement fee is $25.00)

A license is restored on 18 June. A reinstatement fee line of $25.00 is billed on 18 June; the fee falls due with the next monthly fee and is not part of the cure amount.
